title: H-composite Cheon BSGS: corrected composite-order reduction, certified independent collision UCL, declared gap premise

claims.statement: For the protected BLS12-381 G1 auxiliary-powers inputs T=A_1=[s]P0 and A_d=[s^d mod r]P0 with d=2^20, uniform nonzero s, and every integer n>=2^20. ORDER STRUCTURE (corrected): r-1=2^32*u with u odd, so m=(r-1)/2^20 has v2(m)=12 and 6|m, and m is COMPOSITE (m is even and m>2); the set H={x:x^m=1} equals the subgroup of d-th powers, is cyclic of order |H|=m (index d), and mu6 lies in H because 6|m. Cheon's reduction needs no primality of m, and no step anywhere inverts d modulo m (gcd(d,m)=2^12, so such an inverse does not exist): v=s^d lies in H and determines s only up to the d-element kernel {s*zeta^j:zeta^d=1}. Recovery is (i) one d-th-root extraction by 2-Sylow lifting on r-1=2^32*u using u^{-1} mod 2^32 (u odd, so this inverse exists) and (ii) the 2^20-candidate scan of [s*zeta^j]P0 against T, which is charged as its own ledger row; the algorithm is unchanged and only the primality assertion is withdrawn. H-MEMBERSHIP DENSITY: a uniform nonzero residue satisfies q^m=1, i.e. is a d-th power, with probability exactly m/(r-1)=1/d (the m-th-power subgroup has density 1/m and is NOT used); primality costs 1/ln q, so the H-prime density is 1/(d ln q). The attack walks N=65196422678611466571411401699906505=2^115.6503 elements per side on scalars x=a*w, y=a'*w' with a,a' H-primes in disjoint pools inside (2^77,2^97) and w,w' H-primes from the shared walk list of the first 2^50 H-primes above 2^39, so x=a*w<2^174<r lies in H structurally with no character table. Each step is one batched incomplete affine addition priced at the track's C=2000 reference unit plus 238 charged overhead instructions: the itemised rows sum to 198 and are stressed by exactly 6/5, so c=2238/2000=1119/1000. Every row is a complete instruction list, including the scatter counter read/decrement/store, the counting-loop key load (4 per record per pass, so a pass is 25 not 21), the group_runs scan as an explicit ten-instruction op list, a two-limb gap load, and routing as 3 record copies plus a final store. Matching routes the top 85 key bits in 4 hops, orders 63 further bits with 3 LSD counting-sort passes of 21-bit digits, and the group scan compares all four 56-bit limbs, so a match is a full 224-bit key equality; the key is the even one of y,p-y truncated to 224 bits, so one cross-side record pair tests the six points [u]X, u in {+-1,+-omega,+-omega^2}. COVERAGE: success=E[C_distinct]/m with K_cand=6N^2 candidate occurrences v=x/(u x'); under H3occ success=1-exp(-K), K=6N^2/m=51/100. The model error is MEASURED as exact Fractions over SIX censuses on two toy fields (r=8391553, r=33555073) and d in {8,16,64}, each at the production design point K_cand 0.495-0.515, by enumerating the whole candidate set: row A=(pred-D-diag)/m has exact maximum 283/174824=0.00161878 and row B=(pred_eff-D)/m has exact maximum 1421/262236=0.00541879, charged as Fractions, 0.00703757 in total, cell by cell at exactly the declared bound. The transfer is declared, not asserted: the same six cells give |rowB|*sqrt(m)<=4.845 on both axes (field size and d), the random-multiset deviation is O(1/sqrt(m)), and extrapolating that measured coefficient to m=2^234 gives 2^--115.15, i.e. more than 100 bits below the charge actually made (H3occ-scale, named premise, disclosed). KEY COLLISIONS: measured on an INDEPENDENT cross-side experiment at production parity (partK: 16000 records per side from disjoint H-prime pools and disjoint walk lists, so no compared pair shares a factor; the key is the declared even representative; the comparison is cross-side only), which observed ZERO full-key collisions in n=4406549 prefix-equal pairs and whose positive control fires. The rate charged is the CERTIFIED one-sided 95% upper confidence bound R=3/n=2^-20.4863 per compared pair, valid because (1-3/n)^n<=exp(-3)<1/20; no uniform-rate claim is made at 126 or 224 bits. With 2^83.3007 in-group pairs that is 2^62.8144 expected false keys, each verified by one full scalar multiplication, against a 2^88 verification cap (Markov 2^-25.186, charged 2^-25); the ledger closes at any rate at or below 2^-30 and in fact at any rate at or below 2^-6. GAP PREMISE: the walk list is FIXED by the public modulus and start, so no per-run probability is claimed for it; H3gap (declared premise, three-size fit on consecutive H-prime lists at d=8,16,64: mean/law 1.029/0.965/0.985 and KS 0.0303/0.0226/0.0200 against cuts of 0.0393, chi2/dof 0.36/1.01/0.42) gives mean gap mu=d ln q<=2^26.07 and P(max gap over 2^50 > G)<=2^50 exp(-G/mu)=2^-125.6 at the charged G=2^33, so the 2^-40 gap debit is a declared modelling allowance against that premise, not a probability over challenges or coins, and the actual maximum gap on the published list is checkable at the sieving cost already charged. Node occupancy is Chernoff-charged 2^-40 at 6.31x mean. Success after every debit is 0.399504-0.00703757-6.014e-04-2^-25-2^-40-2^-50=0.391865>=39/100. Work is 2*N*2238 instructions for the two walks plus chain tables, per-node fixed work, H-prime supply, the walk list, run-pair cap, 2^88 verification cap, 2-Sylow root extraction and the 2^20-candidate T-scan; an independent order audit on a small j=0 fixture verifies [n]P=O for a prime n with n|#E by brute-force point counting, and no toy point is claimed to have order equal to its scalar modulus. Total W=2^116.812976 units of 2000 instructions < claim 116.8132 < live gate 116.8271 (margin 0.0139). Peak memory 2^125.1 B, no advice, preprocessing inside the total; toy.py recovers s end to end from one secret 12/200 against the enumerated 0.059317 with 0 false positives and both checks ([s]P0=T, s^d=z) passing. CERTIFICATE SCOPE: the certificate recomputes this ledger and the declared model formulas from raw evidence; it establishes arithmetic consistency of the declared premises and does not independently establish production resource bounds, run the production attack, or verify the premises.
